_comment: Per-PR demo for #1349: is_sidestep / is_lateral_pivot evaluate their distance guards in square space. Reuses the about-face input script, which drives a rear move through exactly those maneuver classifiers.
caption: Maneuver classification in square space: a Spearmen regiment is ordered to a destination directly behind it and executes an about-face (conversio) then marches. is_sidestep and is_lateral_pivot now compare move_vec.length_squared() against a squared SIDESTEP_MAX_DISTANCE instead of taking a sqrt, so this is the code path the change touches. Behaviour is intended to be unchanged; the clip is here so a reviewer can confirm the maneuver still reads correctly.
